newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan shipping shares up on direct China links.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan shipping shares up on direct China links.

text.p: Taiwan shipping shares posted moderate gains at mid-session on Friday following China's approval on Thursday for six Taiwan carriers to sail directly across the Taiwan Strait for the first time since 1949.
Brokers said market reaction was not dramatic because the development fell within expectations.

After 70 minutes, Yang Marine, one of three listed shippers approved by China, was up T$0.40 to T$41.50. The other two, Wan Hai Lines and Uniglory Marine, both rose T$0.50 to T$86.50 and T$59, respectively.
"The announcement is certainly good news and the rises in the prices of approved firms reflected that," said Allen Huang, a fund manager for National Securities.
"But it also was news everyone had been expecting, so the share prices already had reflected the news long before Thursday," Huang said.
